description: Look for a word or a few words in everything the work holds as text: the lines of 2021, the marks, the themes, what a machine read in the pictures, what the 2021 document says, and what was heard in about 90 hours of speech (with the exact second). The same search as Find on the site. Returns ids you can `look` at or answer with `say`. What was heard, and the words of pictures marked sensitive, are counted but not shown unless you set open_sensitive. What you look for is not stored, logged or counted.

day.description: Only one day of the first winter, as 2021-11-30 (the day in Prague).

kind.description: Only one kind of place (default all). spelled_another_way: by ear, only where Hindi or Bengali was heard.

offset.description: Skip this many results, to read on.

open_sensitive.description: Set true only if you have decided to read what was heard in the recordings and the words of pictures marked sensitive.

q.description: A word or a few words, found as written (a longer word also as the beginning of a word).

name: search
title: Find a word
